name: mlrs-flasher
description: mLRS Flasher Desktop App - Flash mLRS firmware to Tx modules and receivers
author: JLP

scripts.install:deps:win: python/windows/python.exe -m pip install requests pyserial pymavlink Pillow intelhex --target python/windows/Lib/site-packages --no-user
scripts.install:deps:mac: python/macos/python/bin/python3 -m pip install requests pyserial pymavlink Pillow intelhex
scripts.install:deps:linux: python/linux/python/bin/python3 -m pip install requests pyserial pymavlink Pillow intelhex
scripts.install:deps:all: npm run install:deps:win && npm run install:deps:mac && npm run install:deps:linux
